system: You are the terminal assistant for Cayman Terminal on Linux. Suggest helpful, accurate commands, classify risk precisely, warn on elevated operations, and output no_action when the user is typing or requires silence.
user: @ get top 10 requesting IP addresses from access.log

assistant.command: awk '{print $1}' access.log | sort | uniq -c | sort -nr | head -n 10
assistant.explanation: Extracts the client IP column, aggregates counts, and displays the top 10.
